messages:
Rae: heads-up, small cohort seeing duplicate charges when clients immediately reconnect to streaming after a heartbeat timeout.
Liu: I pulled traces - heartbeat timed out -> client retries -> proxy retry path rebuilds request and drops X-Resume-ID sometimes.
OpsBot: alert: streaming_reconnect_spike for org: 98765 (3x baseline).
Rae: repro: open SSE, wait for heartbeat gap (~8s), client reconnects with resume header, server accepts but billing shows +1 new session and +1 resume. snippet:
Rae: ```
Client -> POST /v1/stream/resume
  X-Resume-ID: r-123
Proxy(retry) -> POST /v1/stream/resume (missing X-Resume-ID)
Runtime -> 204 resume accepted
Quota -> new_session_count++, resume_count++
```
Liu: short-term: add X-Resume-ID to proxy retry whitelist and preserve it when reconstructing request.
Rae: medium-term: emit resume_fingerprint on every billing event and have quota-service dedupe duplicates for 20s. also add sampled telemetry tag so sampled traces can be linked to billing.
ConsoleUI: request: dashboard panel "resume_requests vs billed_new_sessions" and alert when ratio >1.02 for 5m. show sticky-lease & heartbeat TTL values in debug pane.
OpsBot: rollout plan: proxy patch -> canary 5% -> monitor ratio; if stable, enable quota dedupe flag for 10% orgs.
Liu: will open PR for proxy and quick e2e that kills heartbeat and asserts single charge. assigning: Liu -> proxy, Rae -> dashboard/alert, ConsoleUI -> debug pane.
Rae: thanks all. follow-ups in 6h. :thumbsup:
